business.desc: Indicates if it's a business or a personal address.

full_name.desc: Company name (business) of first name and last name (personal).

line_1.desc: Address line 1, i.e. Street address, PO Box.

line_2.desc: Address line 2, i.e. Apartment, Suite, Building.

country_code.desc: The international 2-letter country code as defined by the ISO 3166-1 standard.

full_address.desc: Compact description of the address location, without the full name.

name.desc: Compact description of the address location, including the full name.

notes.desc: A free notes attached to the address. When used as a shipping address, this can be useful to let the customers add specific delivery instructions.

lat.desc: The address geocoded latitude. This is automatically generated when creating a shipping/billing address for an order and a valid geocoder is attached to the order's market.

lng.desc: The address geocoded longitude. This is automatically generated when creating a shipping/billing address for an order and a valid geocoder is attached to the order's market.

is_localized.desc: Indicates if the latitude and logitude are present, either geocoded or manually updated.

is_geocoded.desc: Indicates if the address has been successfully geocoded.

provider_name.desc: The geocoder provider name (either Google or Bing).

map_url.desc: The map url of the geocoded address (if geocoded).

static_map_url.desc: The static map image url of the geocoded address (if geocoded).

billing_info.desc: Customer's billing information (i.e. VAT number, codice fiscale).

recipient_email.desc: The email address of the buyer to invite. An invitation is sent on create when this is set and the buyer organization is not yet bound. Also used to bind and auto-activate when that user registers or accepts.

market_id.desc: The market this agreement applies to (hashid). Can also be set via the market relationship. Market is a Core resource.

billing_address_id.desc: The default billing address for orders placed under this agreement (hashid). Can also be set via the billing_address relationship. Address is a Core resource.

shipping_address_id.desc: The default shipping address for orders placed under this agreement (hashid). Can also be set via the shipping_address relationship. Address is a Core resource.

expires_at.desc: The date/time after which this agreement is no longer valid. When reached, status becomes expired automatically. Must be after starts_at when both are set. Distinct from expired_at.

activated_at.desc: Time at which the agreement was last activated.

deactivated_at.desc: Time at which the agreement was last deactivated.

expired_at.desc: Time at which the agreement status was set to expired. Distinct from expires_at, which is the seller-configured validity end.

cancelled_at.desc: Time at which the agreement was cancelled.

gtm_id_test.desc: The organization's Google Tag Manager ID for test.

can_switch_live.desc: Indicates if the organization can switch to live mode.

api_auth_redirect.desc: Enables the redirect on the new Auth API.

api_fragment_caching_enabled.desc: Enables fragment caching for resources with related directive.

api_rules_engine.desc: Enables the rules engine for flex promotions and price list rules.

api_rules_engine_max_conditions_size.desc: The fallback maximum number of conditions within a rules payload on a ruleable object, default is {API_RULES_ENGINE_MAX_CONDITIONS_SIZE}.

api_rules_engine_max_rules_size.desc: The fallback maximum number of rules within a rules payload on a ruleable object, default is {API_RULES_ENGINE_MAX_RULES_SIZE}.

api_new_auth.desc: Forces the usage of the new Authentication API.

api_purge_single_resource.desc: Enables the purge of cached single resources when list is purged.

api_max_regex_length.desc: The maximum length for the regular expressions, default is {API_MAX_REGEX_LENGTH}.

addresses_avs_check.desc: Indicates if AVS checking will be enforced during payment workflow by passing specific attributes, default is {ADDRESSES_AVS_CHECK}.

addresses_phone_required.desc: Indicates if the phone attribute is required for addresses, default is {ADDRESSES_PHONE_REQUIRED}.

orders_sales_channel_guest_only.desc: Indicates if a sales channel application without customer can read and update just guest orders.

orders_min_rebuild_shipments_lapse.desc: The minimum lapse in fraction of seconds to be observed between two consecutive shipments rebuilt. If shipments rebuilt is triggered within the minimum lapse, the update is performed, but no rebuilt is done.

orders_min_refresh_lapse.desc: The minimum lapse in fraction of seconds to be observed between two consecutive order refreshes. If refresh is triggered within the minimum lapse, the update is performed, but no order refresh is done.

orders_autorefresh_cutoff_test.desc: The maximum number line items allowed for a test order before disabling the autorefresh option.

orders_autorefresh_cutoff_live.desc: The maximum number line items allowed for a live order before disabling the autorefresh option.

orders_number_editable_test.desc: Enables orders number editing as a string in test (for enterprise plans only).

orders_number_editable_live.desc: Enables orders number editing as a string in live (for enterprise plans only).

orders_number_as_reference.desc: Enables to use the order number as payment reference on supported gateways.

orders_invalid_coupon_errors.desc: Enables raising of API errors in case the provided coupon code is invalid, default is {ORDERS_INVALID_COUPON_ERRORS}.

orders_invalid_gift_card_errors.desc: Enables raising of API errors in case the provided gift card code is invalid, default is {ORDERS_INVALID_GIFT_CARD_ERRORS}.

orders_validate_shipping_stock.desc: Enables the validation of the generated stock line items and stock transfers before placing the order, default is {ORDERS_VALIDATE_SHIPPING_STOCK}.

bundles_max_items_count.desc: The maximum number of SKUs allowed for bundles, default is {BUNDLES_MAX_ITEMS_COUNT}.

coupons_min_code_length.desc: The minimum length for coupon code, default is {COUPONS_MIN_CODE_LENGTH}.

coupons_max_code_length.desc: The maximum length for coupon code, default is {COUPONS_MAX_CODE_LENGTH}.

gift_cards_exact_code_matching.desc: Enables matching the gift card code by its exact value, instead of by its first charachters, default is {GIFT_CARDS_EXACT_CODE_MATCHING}.

gift_cards_min_code_length.desc: The minimum length for gift card code, default is {GIFT_CARDS_MIN_CODE_LENGTH}.

gift_cards_max_code_length.desc: The maximum length for gift card code, default is {GIFT_CARDS_MAX_CODE_LENGTH}.

cleanups_max_concurrent_count.desc: The maximum number of concurrent cleanups allowed for your organization, default is {CLEANUPS_MAX_CONCURRENT_COUNT}.

exports_max_concurrent_count.desc: The maximum number of concurrent exports allowed for your organization, default is {EXPORTS_MAX_CONCURRENT_COUNT}.

imports_max_concurrent_count.desc: The maximum number of concurrent imports allowed for your organization, default is {IMPORTS_MAX_CONCURRENT_COUNT}.

imports_purge_cache.desc: Enables purging of cached resources upon succeeded imports.

imports_skip_errors.desc: Disables the interruption of the import in case its errors exceeds the 10% threshold, default is {IMPORTS_SKIP_ERRORS}.

inventory_models_max_stock_locations_cut.desc: The maximum number for stock locations cutoff, default is {INVENTORY_MODELS_MAX_STOCK_LOCATIONS_CUTOFF}.

promotions_max_concurrent_count.desc: The maximum number of active concurrent promotions allowed for your organization, default is {PROMOTIONS_MAX_CONCURRENT_COUNT}.

promotions_max_conditions_size.desc: The maximum number of conditions within a rules payload on a promotion object, default is {PROMOTIONS_MAX_CONDITIONS_SIZE}.

promotions_max_rules_size.desc: The maximum number of rules within a rules payload on a promotion object, default is {PROMOTIONS_MAX_RULES_SIZE}.

price_lists_max_conditions_size.desc: The maximum number of conditions within a rules payload on a price list object, default is {PRICE_LISTS_MAX_CONDITIONS_SIZE}.

price_lists_max_rules_size.desc: The maximum number of rules within a rules payload on a price list object, default is {PRICE_LISTS_MAX_RULES_SIZE}.

imports_trigger_webhooks.desc: Enables triggering of webhooks during imports, default is {IMPORTS_TRIGGER_WEBHOOKS}.

discount_engines_enabled.desc: Enables the use of an external discount engine in place of the standard one, default is {DISCOUNT_ENGINES_ENABLED}.

discount_engines_errors.desc: Enables raising of API errors in case of discount engine failure, default is {DISCOUNT_ENGINES_ERRORS}.

tags_max_name_length.desc: The maximum length for the tag name, default is {TAGS_MAX_NAME_LENGTH}.

tags_max_allowed_number.desc: The maximum allowed number of tags for each resource, default is {TAGS_MAX_ALLOWED_NUMBER}.

tax_calculators_errors.desc: Enables raising of API errors in case of tax calculation failure, default is {TAX_CALCULATORS_ERRORS}.

external_promotions_errors.desc: Enables raising of API errors in case of external promotion failure, default is {EXTERNAL_PROMOTIONS_ERRORS}.

external_prices_errors.desc: Enables raising of API errors in case of external price failure, default is {EXTERNAL_PRICES_ERRORS}.

skus_discovery.desc: Enables the Sku discovery by similarity search.

payment_gateways_transaction_on_event.desc: Enables the creation of the authorization when the gateway event is received, even if there is no reference on Commerce Layer.

refunds_check_for_pending.desc: Enables blocking a new refund (or compensation) on a capture while an earlier async refund on the same capture is still unresolved.
